title: Self-hosted applications with free OIDC login
notes: These projects can be self-hosted and provide basic OIDC/OAuth2 login without buying an SSO add-on.
You still need an OIDC identity provider, such as Keycloak, authentik, or Zitadel.
Hosting, support, advanced provisioning, and group-sync features may have separate commercial offerings. Verify the feature against the version you deploy.
Outline is included because its free self-hosted edition includes OIDC, but its current BSL-1.1 license is not OSI-approved open source.
Directus is included because its self-hosted edition includes OIDC without a paid add-on, but its current MSCL-1.0 license is source-available rather than OSI-approved open source.
HashiCorp Vault is included because its self-hosted edition includes OIDC login without a paid add-on, but its current BSL-1.1 license is not OSI-approved open source.
